# Opening Page

The witness keeps one hand on the locked door and one hand over the torn page.

"If I sign this, my brother loses the only route out," she says.

The investigator does not answer at once. The lamp shakes on the table, and the ink line crawls across the name she tried to hide.

He has to choose before dawn: protect the witness, or let the ledger vanish with the person who can still speak.

Who moves first when the guard knocks again?
